visual_action: A static shot of a document formatted as an official presidential proclamation from the White House. The document is titled 'HONORING THE VICTIMS OF THE TRAGEDY IN MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA' and dated August 27, 2025. It is signed by 'DONALD J. TRUMP'.

cast.name: Donald J. Trump
cast.evidence: His name, 'DONALD J. TRUMP', is at the bottom of the proclamation as the signatory. The text is presented as his official order as President.

on_screen_text.text: HONORING THE VICTIMS OF THE TRAGEDY IN MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA

As a mark of respect for the victims of the senseless acts of violence perpetrated on August 27, 2025, in Minneapolis, Minnesota, by the authority vested in me as President of the United States by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, I hereby order that the flag of the United States shall be flown at half-staff at the White House and upon all public buildings and grounds, at all military posts and naval stations, and on all naval vessels of the Federal Government in the District of Columbia and throughout the United States and its Territories and possessions until sunset, August 31, 2025. I also direct that the flag shall be flown at half-staff for the same length of time at all United States embassies, legations, consular offices, and other facilities abroad, including all military facilities and naval vessels and stations.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand this twenty-seventh day of August, in the year of our Lord two thousand twenty-five, and of the Independence of the United States of America the two hundred and fiftieth.

manipulation_or_satire: The video displays a fabricated presidential proclamation from Donald J. Trump dated August 27, 2025. It is a staged document concerning a hypothetical future 'tragedy in Minneapolis, Minnesota', presented as authentic to imply such an event will happen.
central_claim: The post claims that a major tragedy will occur in Minneapolis on August 27, 2025, and presents a fabricated proclamation to show how Donald Trump would respond as president.
intended_effect: To instill fear about a future tragedy and portray Donald Trump as a strong, presidential leader prepared to handle it.
